subject: [hw] T02 -> V40: fake n2vc_hw ready for /dev/vcu tests (record + script grammar)
body:
Same fake as posted to IV: n2vc_hw_open_fake(out, record_path), plus tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.h for n2vc_hw_fake_script()/violations()/set_poll_timeout(). For GCE translation tests you can script a poll to succeed:
  after write VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 -> set VENC 0x0018 0x00000004
  read VENC 0x0018 returns 0x00000004
and a done interrupt:
  irq 0 fires 0 ms after write VENC 0x0010 0x00000001
Note hw->regs() has no per-batch poll timeout (frozen signature), so fake POLL uses a default 100 ms; call n2vc_hw_fake_set_poll_timeout(h, us) for timeout tests. Tell me if V40 needs a way to set a register window default (e.g. VDEC_SYS bit 4) or a block-power precondition helper; I can add a `set` script line before DONE.
